content_en.title: Multi-Branch Barbershop Website
content_en.summary: A redesign for a premium barbershop with five branches. Customers search by branch, service and date, compare branches by queue and rating, and book a barber and time slot; staff run the day from a calendar per barber.
content_en.challenge:
The old site opened with a slogan over an interior photo, followed by a cut-off paragraph and a large empty area. Prices sat on a separate page, and every reservation button led to the same WhatsApp number, so customers could not choose a branch, a barber or a time.

Five branches were listed without opening hours, map links or any sign of how busy they were. The free membership and birthday discount were mentioned only in the top bar, the Instagram embed failed to load, and the copy switched between English and Indonesian.
content_en.solution:
The homepage opens with a search for branch, service and date, followed by branch cards showing rating, chairs and the current queue, then the full price list with durations. Each branch has its own page with a photo gallery, services that can be added to a booking, barbers, reviews, opening hours, and a booking card that stays in view.

Booking moves through service, barber, time and confirmation: dates are picked from a strip and open times from a list, with full slots disabled and the summary kept on the right. Members see upcoming bookings, the birthday discount and the style notes barbers write after each cut. Behind the counter, a partner calendar shows every barber as a column with bookings, walk-ins and breaks. The planned production stack is Next.js with Supabase.
features: Branch, service and date search on the homepage
Branch cards with rating, chairs and current queue
Branch page with gallery, services, barbers, reviews and hours
Booking flow by service, barber, date and time
Free WhatsApp-based membership with a birthday discount
Barber style notes saved after every visit
Partner calendar per barber for bookings and walk-ins

content_id.title: Website Barbershop Multi-Cabang
content_id.summary: Redesign untuk barbershop premium dengan lima cabang. Pelanggan mencari berdasarkan cabang, layanan, dan tanggal, membandingkan cabang dari antrean dan rating, lalu booking kapster dan jam; staf mengatur hari dari kalender per kapster.
content_id.challenge:
Situs lama dibuka dengan slogan di atas foto interior, disusul paragraf yang terpotong dan area kosong yang besar. Harga ada di halaman terpisah, dan semua tombol reservasi mengarah ke nomor WhatsApp yang sama, sehingga pelanggan tidak bisa memilih cabang, kapster, atau jam.

Lima cabang ditampilkan tanpa jam buka, link peta, atau gambaran seberapa ramai. Member gratis dan diskon ulang tahun hanya disebut di top bar, embed Instagram gagal dimuat, dan bahasanya berganti-ganti antara Inggris dan Indonesia.
content_id.solution:
Beranda dibuka dengan pencarian cabang, layanan, dan tanggal, diikuti kartu cabang yang menampilkan rating, jumlah kursi, dan antrean saat ini, lalu daftar harga lengkap dengan durasi. Setiap cabang punya halaman sendiri dengan galeri foto, layanan yang bisa ditambahkan ke booking, kapster, ulasan, jam buka, dan kartu booking yang selalu terlihat.

Booking berjalan dari layanan, kapster, waktu, sampai konfirmasi: tanggal dipilih dari deret tanggal dan jam dari daftar, slot penuh tidak bisa dipilih, dan ringkasan tetap di kanan. Member melihat booking mendatang, diskon ulang tahun, dan catatan gaya yang ditulis kapster setelah setiap potongan. Di balik meja kasir, kalender partner menampilkan setiap kapster sebagai kolom berisi booking, walk-in, dan jam istirahat. Stack produksi yang direncanakan adalah Next.js dengan Supabase.
features: Pencarian cabang, layanan, dan tanggal di beranda
Kartu cabang dengan rating, kursi, dan antrean saat ini
Halaman cabang dengan galeri, layanan, kapster, ulasan, dan jam buka
Alur booking per layanan, kapster, tanggal, dan jam
Member gratis berbasis WhatsApp dengan diskon ulang tahun
Catatan gaya dari kapster tersimpan setiap kunjungan
Kalender partner per kapster untuk booking dan walk-in
